basic_details.job_title: RRC Southern Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 67 Posts

important_dates.sports trial date: To be announced on the RRC Chennai website

application_fee.details: The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway. The applicable refund will be provided only to candidates who appear in the sports trial.

age_limit.details: No upper or lower age relaxation is permissible under this recruitment.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess the prescribed recognised sports achievements for the pay level for which they apply. The required standard varies according to the level and may include representation or medal-winning performance in recognised: | Olympic Games World Championships or World Cups Asian Games Commonwealth Games Asian Championships or Asian Cups South Asian Federation Games National Championships National Games All India Inter-University Championships National School Games and other recognised competitions | The recognised sports achievement must have been obtained on or after 1 April 2024 and up to the notification date. Applicants must be active sportspersons.

selection_process: The Southern Railway Sports Quota selection process includes:
Screening of online applications Sports trial Assessment of recognised sports achievements Assessment of educational qualification Document verification Medical examination
how_to_apply: Visit the RRC Chennai website at rrcmas.in.
Complete the candidate registration using a valid email address and mobile number.
Select the correct pay level, sports discipline, event or playing position.
Enter the personal, educational and sports-achievement details.
Upload the required photograph, signature and self-attested certificates.
Pay the application fee through the online payment gateway.
Review the completed form and submit it before 25 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Save the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only through online mode. No vacancy is exclusively reserved for a community such as SC, ST or OBC. Candidates applying for more than one sports discipline, event or pay level must submit separate applications and pay separate fees. The exact pay level and place of posting will be decided by Southern Railway at the time of appointment. Original certificates must be produced during the trial and document verification. Selected candidates must execute a service bond for five years. Selected sportspersons will be on probation for two years.

content_sections.heading: Southern Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.date_and_time: To be announced on the RRC Chennai website

content_sections.heading: Level 4 and Level 5 Sports Vacancies
content_sections.text: If suitable candidates are unavailable for a sports discipline under Level 4 or Level 5, the vacancies may be filled under Level 2 or Level 3 from the same discipline.

rows.event_position: Left-Arm Spinner, Right Top-Order Batsman and Left-Hand Top-Order Batsman
Middle Blocker and Universal Opposite Hitter
100m, 200m, 400m Hurdles, Hammer Throw and Discus Throw
65-70 Kg, 70-75 Kg, 80-85 Kg and Above 90 Kg
54-57 Kg, 57-60 Kg, 65-70 Kg and Above 80 Kg
Left-Arm Spinner/Top-Order Batsman, Right Top-Order Batsman and Left-Arm Fast Bowler
Opening Batsmen and Top-Order Batsmen/Off Spinner

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates awaiting the final examination or final results are not eligible. No relaxation will be provided in the minimum educational qualification.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: 10th Pass, ITI, equivalent qualification or National Apprenticeship Certificate granted by NCVT
12th Pass or equivalent; for technical categories, Matriculation with completed Act Apprenticeship or ITI approved by NCVT/SCVT

content_sections.heading: Typing Requirement
content_sections.text: Candidates appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must acquire a typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi within four years from the date of appointment. Until the typing requirement is fulfilled, the appointment will remain provisional.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: No upper or lower age relaxation is permissible under this recruitment.

rows.18_years: Between 2 January 2002 and 1 January 2009, both dates inclusive

content_sections.heading: Sports Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed recognised sports achievements for the pay level for which they apply. The required standard varies according to the level and may include representation or medal-winning performance in recognised: Olympic Games World Championships or World Cups Asian Games Commonwealth Games Asian Championships or Asian Cups South Asian Federation Games National Championships National Games All India Inter-University Championships National School Games and other recognised competitions The recognised sports achievement must have been obtained on or after 1 April 2024 and up to the notification date. Applicants must be active sportspersons.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway. The applicable refund will be provided only to candidates who appear in the sports trial.

rows.category: SC, ST, Women, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Minority and Economically Backward Class candidates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Southern Railway Sports Quota selection process includes: Screening of online applications Sports trial Assessment of recognised sports achievements Assessment of educational qualification Document verification Medical examination

content_sections.heading: Selection Marks
content_sections.text: Only candidates declared fit in the sports trial will be considered for the remaining stages.

rows.selection_component: Game skill, physical fitness and coach's observations during trial

content_sections.heading: Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: If two candidates obtain equal marks, the younger candidate will receive preference in the merit list.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Upload
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Sports achievement certificates Class 10 certificate showing the date of birth Community certificate, where applicable Fee-concession certificate, where applicable Recent colour photograph Scanned signature No Objection Certificate for serving employees

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Southern Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the RRC Chennai website at rrcmas.in . Open Employment Notice RRC-02/Sports/2026-27. Complete the candidate registration using a valid email address and mobile number. Select the correct pay level, sports discipline, event or playing position. Enter the personal, educational and sports-achievement details. Upload the required photograph, signature and self-attested certificates. Pay the application fee through the online payment gateway. Review the completed form and submit it before 25 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Save the submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only through online mode. No vacancy is exclusively reserved for a community such as SC, ST or OBC. Candidates applying for more than one sports discipline, event or pay level must submit separate applications and pay separate fees. The exact pay level and place of posting will be decided by Southern Railway at the time of appointment. Original certificates must be produced during the trial and document verification. Selected candidates must execute a service bond for five years. Selected sportspersons will be on probation for two years.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: Southern Railway has announced 67 Sports Quota vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 25 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years as of 1 January 2027. No age relaxation is permitted.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Level 1?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 10th Pass, ITI, equivalent qualification or NAC granted by NCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for Level 2 and Level 3?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed the 12th standard or possess the prescribed Matriculation and technical qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for Level 4 and Level 5?
faq.answer: A graduation degree from a government-recognised institution is required.
